Question
========
When are relational databases most useful?

Answerlist
----------
* unstructured big data
* well-structured data with relationships
* for data with complex hierarchy and lots of meaningful relationships between entities
* for data collected from various sources that might therefore come in different formats


Solution
========
Relational databases are most useful for well-structured data with relationships.

Answerlist
----------
* False
